thread:
marta-cs: Day0 check-in for Shadowpark private/VPC deploy. Main asks: network routes, fw rules, IAM roles for service accounts, KMS key access (rotate window), and audit log forwarding. Can infra & sec confirm blockers? :wave:
sam-eng: copying the onboarding checklist here — we need the VPC peering CID ranges and NAT gateway plan. Also need the customer to confirm egress endpoints for Splunk/SIEM.
raj-sre: I ran an initial smoke test from our staging router — traffic to the customer VPC is routing but packet loss ~0.8% on one az. tagging @olivia-ops for network triage.
olivia-ops: looking now, will check the peering routes and firewall rules. Quick Q: does Shadowpark want source-NAT or proxy egress? That changes 2 ACLs.
leo-security: Shadowpark's compliance requires KMS usable by the Redwood connector principal only, and audit logs to ship to their Splunk index shadowpark-logs. Need policy snippet from them.
marta-cs: they asked for connector-only KMS. Sam, can you share the IAM trust JSON we recommend so they can provision minimal role?
sam-eng: posted recommended trust/permissions:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-connector"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```
Use kms:Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey on the key policy.
raj-sre: for the packet loss, switching to the backup peering endpoint reduces loss to <0.1%. Recommend we move cutover to backup and re-run smoke.
olivia-ops: confirming firewall rules — customer had a deny on ephemeral ports 32768-61000. We need to open 49152-65535 for our current NAT path, or we can suggest using proxy to limit ports.
leo-security: also: log retention requirement? Shadowpark requested 2y retention for audit logs. That may bump costs — flag to renewals team for potential pricing impact.
marta-cs: added renewal-risk note. @raj-sre can you create a short runbook entry for failover to backup peering and drop it here?
raj-sre: done — runbook snippet:
```
1) Update route table rt-xyz to point to peering-id-ALT
2) Flush conntrack on gateways
3) Verify via curl to /health endpoint from 3 azs
4) If >1% loss, roll back
```
marta-cs: perfect. next actions: olivia to confirm firewall change with customer; sam to post IAM/KMS guidance in support ticket; leo to confirm log shipping retention and cost delta; raj to perform peering failover smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll capture these in the account health doc and ping renewal next week. Thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Scheduled runbook job: peering-failover-test queued for 2025-06-12T09:30:00Z — status: pending
olivia-ops: note — customer prefers rolling change window 09:30-10:30 PT, asking for 15m heads-up. I'll sync with them and update ticket.
marta-cs: great, closing day0 sync. keep updates in this thread; if anything urgent DM me. :rocket:
